summary: Full end-to-end test of the REDESIGNED player-placed bounty system (Sistema de Cacería). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass — config defaults, targets auth guard + shape, contract place/charge/board/mine, minimum validation, 1-active-per-user limit, insufficient-funds no-charge, atomic+idempotent simulate-kill on contracts, self-bounty start/limit/board/mine, self-bounty kill history entry, WS bounty:state + ping/pong, and WS broadcast on contract place. Frontend: /bounty hub renders (LA CACERÍA title, self CTA, target list with sid-scoped hunt buttons, WANTED board with rich BountyCard, admin panel present). Contract modal opens on hunt click; placing publishes a WANTED entry with a cancel button in bounty-mine-list; cancel refunds the wallet. bounty-widget renders on /dashboard when a bounty is active; /bounty/overlay renders the featured bounty card. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: bounty.py _sim_roster generates sids that overflow int64 (76561190000000000+idx*1337+11) — currently stored as str, fine, but simulate-kill fallback str(int(target_sid)+1) will crash if target_sid is a non-numeric sid from the real game roster. Consider using a safe fallback for non-numeric killer_sid.

bounty.py _resolve_death: contracts still update to status=completed BEFORE the self-kill branch checks self_bounty. Since IDs are separate rows this is fine, but on_kill logs 'múltiple' as bountyId in _discord_completed instead of an actual id — cosmetic only.
server.py is >19k lines — file size guideline violated; player-placed bounty wiring block (~18843–18949) could live inside bounty.py or an adapters module for better modularity.
bounty.py: WS auth relies on jwt_secret being passed via configure(); wired correctly in server.py, but there is no test for the WS uid-tagged path (only unauthenticated WS is tested). Non-blocking.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo -> {token}; demo user is admin with >5M PrimeMeat. Store token in localStorage under key 'primal_token'.
seed_data_creation: None. Sim roster auto-generated by bounty.py. Test suite auto-cleans placer contracts before each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sistema de Cacería backend endpoints are prefixed /api/bounty/*. WS at /api/bounty/ws?token=<jwt> pushes {event:bounty:state,data:{config,board,paused}} on connect. Contract placer wallet flow uses /api/auth/me for verification. All 12 pytests in /app/backend/tests/test_bounty.py should pass consistently; the fixture auto-cancels the demo user's active contracts before each test. Preview always runs with simulated=true roster (10 SIM players). Preview may show a lingering self-bounty from an earlier user (e.g. SURVIVOR_5964); it does not affect testing but placer flows for the demo user work regardless.
